newmoon: Sun and Moon meet, and the month begins in the dark. Nothing is visible yet, which is the point: this is the moment for starting things rather than judging them. Intentions set now have the whole cycle to grow, and the mood is quiet, inward and slightly expectant.
firstquarter: A week in, the Moon is half lit and pulling away from the Sun. What began at the New Moon meets its first resistance, and the question is whether to push on or let it go. Energy runs high and a little impatient. Decisions made now give the month its shape.
fullmoon: Sun and Moon face each other across the sky and the Moon is wholly lit. What was begun in the dark is now visible, for better or worse. Feeling runs at its peak, sleep runs short, and whatever has been building for two weeks comes to a head.
lastquarter: The Moon is half lit again, now on its way back toward the Sun. The month's momentum is spent and the work is sorting: what to keep, what to finish, what to release before the next New Moon. The mood is reflective, a little tired, and clearer for it.
newmoon-in-aries: A new cycle starts hot. Sun and Moon together in the first sign favour clean beginnings, bold openings and anything that needs courage more than planning. Starts made now are fast and a little rash. The month that follows rewards initiative and punishes hesitation.
newmoon-in-taurus: The month begins slowly and on solid ground. Intentions set now are about money, the body, comfort and what lasts, and they are best kept simple. Seeds planted in Taurus grow at their own pace. Patience in the first days pays off in the weeks after.
newmoon-in-gemini: A month of talk, letters and short journeys opens. The mood is curious and quick, and intentions multiply faster than they can be kept. Good for beginning a study, a correspondence or a conversation long put off. The risk is scattering the start across too many things.
newmoon-in-cancer: The cycle opens at home. Sun and Moon in the Moon's own sign turn the month toward family, shelter, food and the people who need no introduction. Feelings run close to the surface and memory is sharp. Beginnings here are quiet, protective and slow to show themselves.
newmoon-in-leo: The month starts with a flourish. Intentions set now want an audience, and the mood is warm, proud and generous. Good for launching anything creative or anything that needs confidence to carry it. The shadow is a start made for show that has no second act.
newmoon-in-virgo: A cycle of sorting and mending begins. The New Moon in Virgo favours small practical intentions, health routines, tidied desks and work done properly. The mood is modest and exacting. Big launches feel wrong here. The month rewards whoever starts with the details.
newmoon-in-libra: The month opens on other people. Partnerships, agreements and the balance between giving and taking are what the cycle is about, and beginnings made with someone else fare better than solo ones. The mood is courteous and a little indecisive. Fairness is the intention worth setting.
newmoon-in-scorpio: The cycle begins in deep water. Intentions set now are private, intense and about what lies under the surface: debts, desire, loyalty, endings that free something up. The mood is guarded and resolute. Beginnings here are rarely announced and rarely abandoned.
newmoon-in-sagittarius: A month of reach begins. Sun and Moon in Sagittarius favour travel, study, faith and any intention that points past the horizon. The mood is hopeful and expansive, sometimes carelessly so. Starts made now are large in scope and need the details filled in later.
newmoon-in-capricorn: The cycle opens with a plan. Intentions set now are about work, ambition, duty and structures that will stand. The mood is sober and serious, and the month that follows rewards discipline over inspiration. Beginnings here are slow, deliberate and built to last.
newmoon-in-aquarius: The month begins at a distance. Sun and Moon in Aquarius favour intentions about groups, ideas, reform and friendship rather than anything merely personal. The mood is cool, clear and a little contrary. Beginnings here break with how things were done before.
newmoon-in-pisces: The cycle begins in a haze. Intentions set now are felt rather than stated, and the month favours rest, imagination, compassion and quiet retreat over any firm agenda. Boundaries are soft and so is the will. Beginnings here surface slowly, like something remembered.
firstquarter-in-aries: The Moon in Aries squares the Sun in Capricorn, and the month's plan meets a burst of impatience. What was carefully begun now wants to move faster than it can. Tempers are quick and so are decisions. The useful work is to push, but on one front rather than three.
firstquarter-in-taurus: The Moon in Taurus squares the Sun in Aquarius, and the month's new idea runs into the need for something solid. Resistance comes as stubbornness and a wish for comfort. Money and the body ask for attention. The task is to ground the plan without smothering it.
firstquarter-in-gemini: The Moon in Gemini squares the Sun in Pisces, and the month's dreamy start meets a flood of questions. Talk speeds up, plans change, and nothing stays still long enough to be felt. Nerves are quick and attention is short. The task is to put words to what was only sensed.
firstquarter-in-cancer: The Moon in Cancer squares the Sun in Aries, and the month's bold start runs into feeling. Home, family and old habits pull against the new venture, and moods are tender and defensive. The useful work is to find out what the heart actually wants from the plan.
firstquarter-in-leo: The Moon in Leo squares the Sun in Taurus, and the month's steady start wants recognition. Pride is engaged, and so is the wish to be seen doing the thing rather than merely doing it. Drama runs a little high. The task is to keep the warmth and lose the show.
firstquarter-in-virgo: The Moon in Virgo squares the Sun in Gemini, and the month's many ideas meet the demand that they be made to work. Criticism is sharp, the details press, and nerves fray over small things. The task is to pick one thread and finish it properly.
firstquarter-in-libra: The Moon in Libra squares the Sun in Cancer, and the month's private needs meet other people's. Relationships ask for fairness and the mood swings between pleasing and resenting. Decisions are weighed too long. The useful work is to say plainly what is wanted and listen for the answer.
firstquarter-in-scorpio: The Moon in Scorpio squares the Sun in Leo, and the month's proud start meets a deeper and less flattering motive. Feeling runs intense and guarded, and something kept hidden presses to be acknowledged. Power is in question. The task is honesty, with others and in private.
firstquarter-in-sagittarius: The Moon in Sagittarius squares the Sun in Virgo, and the month's careful work wants a bigger horizon. Restlessness and impatience with the details are the mood, and the urge is to leap before the ground is checked. The task is to widen the plan without abandoning it.
firstquarter-in-capricorn: The Moon in Capricorn squares the Sun in Libra, and the month's search for balance runs into the need to get things done. Duty presses, feeling turns sober, and partnerships are weighed against ambition. The task is to build something the agreement can stand on.
firstquarter-in-aquarius: The Moon in Aquarius squares the Sun in Scorpio, and the month's deep private current meets a wish for air and distance. Feeling cools and turns to principle, and friends or groups pull against intimacy. The task is to see the situation from outside without leaving it.
firstquarter-in-pisces: The Moon in Pisces squares the Sun in Sagittarius, and the month's confident reach meets doubt and tiredness. Boundaries soften, plans blur, and the mood is dreamy or discouraged by turns. Imagination is strong. The task is to rest enough to tell a vision from an escape.
fullmoon-in-aries: The Moon in Aries faces the Sun in Libra, and the month's tension is between standing alone and keeping the peace. Tempers run short and the urge to act outruns the urge to consult. Something begun two weeks ago demands a decision now. Patience is scarce and worth finding.
fullmoon-in-taurus: The Moon in Taurus faces the Sun in Scorpio, and the pull is between holding on and letting go. Money, possessions and bodily comfort come up against deeper and less comfortable wants. Feeling is steady but stubborn. What has been accumulating now has to be weighed.
fullmoon-in-gemini: The Moon in Gemini faces the Sun in Sagittarius, and the axis is facts against meaning. Everyone has something to say and much of it is said at once. News arrives, plans change, conversations peak. The mood is restless and bright, with little patience for sitting still.
fullmoon-in-cancer: The Moon in its own sign faces the Sun in Capricorn, and home is weighed against work. Feelings are strong, memories close, and the need to be looked after sits awkwardly beside the day's obligations. Family matters come to a head. Tears are near and not unwelcome.
fullmoon-in-leo: The Moon in Leo faces the Sun in Aquarius, and the axis is the individual against the group. Pride is touchy, hearts are open and everyone wants to be seen. Something creative or romantic reaches its climax. The mood is warm, dramatic and hard to keep private.
fullmoon-in-virgo: The Moon in Virgo faces the Sun in Pisces, and order is weighed against surrender. Small things loom large, health and routine demand attention, and criticism comes easily. The useful work is sorting what can be fixed from what has to be accepted. Nerves run a little thin.
fullmoon-in-libra: The Moon in Libra faces the Sun in Aries, and the question is how much to give way. Relationships reach a point of decision, and fairness is argued over more than it is practised. The mood is sociable but strained. Partnerships that have been drifting are seen clearly now.
fullmoon-in-scorpio: The Moon in Scorpio faces the Sun in Taurus, and what was buried comes to the surface. Jealousy, debt, desire and loyalty are all in play, and feeling runs deep and unsentimental. Something ends so that something else can be kept. The mood is intense and private.
fullmoon-in-sagittarius: The Moon in Sagittarius faces the Sun in Gemini, and the pull is between the big picture and the small print. Restlessness peaks, travel and distant places call, and opinions are held loudly. Truth matters more than tact. The mood is high and a little careless.
fullmoon-in-capricorn: The Moon in Capricorn faces the Sun in Cancer, and duty is weighed against need. Work, status and responsibility press on home and feeling, and the result is a sober mood with ambition in it. Something built over months is tested. Rest is wanted and hard to take.
fullmoon-in-aquarius: The Moon in Aquarius faces the Sun in Leo, and belonging is weighed against standing out. Friendships, causes and groups come to the front, feeling turns cool and detached, and the odd idea is suddenly the right one. Something settled is questioned. Distance helps.
fullmoon-in-pisces: The Moon in Pisces faces the Sun in Virgo, and feeling floods the details. Compassion runs high, boundaries run thin, and tiredness and tears are near. Dreams are vivid and the imagination is loud. The useful work is letting go of what cannot be sorted.
lastquarter-in-aries: The Moon in Aries squares the Sun in Cancer, and the month's winding down is impatient. The urge is to cut losses fast and move on, while home and feeling ask for a gentler ending. Tempers are short. The useful work is finishing what was started rather than starting again.
lastquarter-in-taurus: The Moon in Taurus squares the Sun in Leo, and the month's closing weeks turn stubborn. What has been proudly built is weighed against what it costs to keep, and comfort wins arguments over glory. The mood is slow and practical. The task is deciding what is worth holding.
lastquarter-in-gemini: The Moon in Gemini squares the Sun in Virgo, and the month's careful work is talked over and picked apart. Loose ends multiply, messages pile up, and attention jumps from one unfinished thing to the next. Nerves are busy. The task is to tie off a few threads and let the rest go.
lastquarter-in-cancer: The Moon in Cancer squares the Sun in Libra, and the month's balancing act pulls against the need to withdraw. Feeling turns tender and defensive, and old attachments resurface. Partnerships are felt more than discussed. The useful work is a quiet retreat without a sulk.
lastquarter-in-leo: The Moon in Leo squares the Sun in Scorpio, and the month's deep current is met with pride. What has been hidden wants a more dignified ending than it is getting, and the heart resists being told. The mood is warm but touchy. The task is to let go without a scene.
lastquarter-in-virgo: The Moon in Virgo squares the Sun in Sagittarius, and the month's large ambitions are audited. The details that were skipped now itemise themselves, and the mood turns critical and a little anxious. Health and routine ask for care. The task is honest tidying, not self-reproach.
lastquarter-in-libra: The Moon in Libra squares the Sun in Capricorn, and the month's work is weighed against the people it affected. Agreements are reviewed, fairness is argued, and the mood is polite and strained. Something has to be renegotiated. The useful work is a settlement both sides can live with.
lastquarter-in-scorpio: The Moon in Scorpio squares the Sun in Aquarius, and the month's cool ideals are tested against what was actually felt. Resentments surface, loyalties are counted, and the mood is intense and private. Something is released, not without a struggle. The task is an honest ending.
lastquarter-in-sagittarius: The Moon in Sagittarius squares the Sun in Pisces, and the month's drift is met with a wish for a clear direction. Restlessness and faith run together, and the urge is to leave rather than resolve. The mood is hopeful but scattered. The task is choosing one road out.
lastquarter-in-capricorn: The Moon in Capricorn squares the Sun in Aries, and the month's rush is brought to account. What was launched in haste now has to be made to work or let go, and the mood turns sober and dutiful. Fatigue is real. The task is a disciplined close without bitterness.
lastquarter-in-aquarius: The Moon in Aquarius squares the Sun in Taurus, and the month's solid gains are questioned from a distance. Attachment loosens, friends and ideas pull against comfort and possession, and the mood is cool and restless. The task is to see what should change and what should simply stay.
lastquarter-in-pisces: The Moon in Pisces squares the Sun in Gemini, and the month's chatter dissolves into feeling. Facts blur, tiredness sets in, and what was argued about is now simply sensed. Compassion is high and resolve is low. The useful work is rest, forgiveness and leaving the loose ends alone.
